provenance.no-hover-rule: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — grepped the whole of Table.css case-insensitively for "hover": zero matches. No other Salt column in this pipeline has confirmed a total absence of any hover mechanism at all.
provenance.no-selection-rule: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — grepped Table.css/TR.tsx/TH.tsx/TD.tsx in full for "select"/"disabled" in a ROW (not cell-content) context: no selected-row or disabled-row concept exists anywhere.
provenance.zebra-dead-code: Table.css defines `.saltTable-zebra-tertiary` but Table.tsx's own clsx() call (`{ [withTableBaseName("zebra")]: zebra }`) only ever emits a bare `saltTable-zebra` class, never `zebra-{variant}` — so that selector can never match real rendered output. See style.row.zebra's own note.
provenance.overflow-region: TableContainer.tsx: checkOverflow() reads element.scrollHeight/clientHeight and scrollWidth/clientWidth via a real useResizeObserver + useIsomorphicLayoutEffect-on-mount, and only THEN sets role="region"/tabIndex=0/aria-labelledby (forwarded from the table's own id via TableContext) — a genuinely dynamic, measured a11y upgrade, not a static class.
